mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees with clear skies over Fireman Park and a waxing crescent moon above.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote by the Common Council. This long-range strategy focuses on developing strong neighborhoods, supporting our local business hub, and prioritizing sustainable land stewardship.

There is plenty to do in town with Hop Haus Trivia taking place today. Tomorrow, you can check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join the trivia fun at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, or Lake Lou-ee.
Regarding the weekly police report, on October 3, an officer located a 19-year-old man driving with expired registration who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM.
